messages:
Ivy (Design): quick idea 1 - add a tiny "mini-export" affordance in the trace drilldown so users can download just the span JSON. inline, next to span metadata.
Ravi (Frontend): inline sounds handy. perf note: don't render export buttons for thousands of spans. lazy-mount and reuse a single DOM node via portal.
Sofia (Product): support asks for both 'Minimal export (ids+meta)' and 'Full export (JSON)'. a small help tooltip explaining the difference would reduce tickets.
Liam (Eng Runtime): security: full export must obey org redaction rules. minimal export safe by default. large full exports should be async and return a presigned url.
June (A11y): accessibility: export control must be keyboard reachable and use proper aria attributes (aria-haspopup=menu). announce success with aria-live. focus must return to trigger after modal close.
Tess (Support): can we add a copy correlation id micro-action too? people paste that into tickets all the time. include helper copy text: 'Paste this ID into a support ticket or search field.'
Ravi (Frontend): implementation: menu items: Copy correlation ID, Export minimal JSON, Export full JSON. Keyboard: Enter/Space to open, Arrow keys to navigate.
June (A11y): avoid single-key global shortcuts. if you add opt-in shortcuts, document them and make them configurable. check contrast for helper text.
Ivy (Design): copy button label should be explicit: 'Copy correlation ID'. no ambiguous copy.
Sofia (Product): analytics: track ui.export.clicked (format, user_role, redaction_applied) and ui.copy.correlation_id. keep events minimal and scrub PII.
BuildBot: deploy queued: frontend/inline-mini-export -> staging 2024-07-02 11:00 UTC :white_check_mark:
Liam (Eng Runtime): I'll spec the presign TTL and redaction flow in infra ticket.
Ravi (Frontend): I'll prototype the lazy menu and post a demo link by Wed.
June (A11y): will run a quick checklist once demo is up.
Ivy (Design): Action items: Ravi prototype, Liam infra spec, June a11y review, Tess support blurb, Sofia analytics spec. tagging: @Ravi @Liam @June @Tess @Sofia
Ravi (Frontend): on it, demo soon. :thumbsup:
Sofia (Product): thanks team, should cut down a bunch of support friction.
Ivy (Design): closing after demo + infra signoff. :sparkles:
